text:
Liz H: Quick heads-up — proposing SDK v25.3 rollout today at 15:00 PT (phased canary: 1% -> 25% -> 100%). No breaking body changes expected; main change is optional header-based routing (X-Redwood-Version). Pinged owners below.
Devon: Any request/response schema changes we should flag to mobile/web?
Maria (DevEx): No schema/body changes. Only an optional header. We'll add a deprecation warning path server-side for clients that omit the header. Example shim we plan to log: 
```js
if (!req.headers['x-redwood-version']) {
  logger.warn('legacy-client', {cid: req.client_id});
}
```
Aj Patel: I can own the canary run. I'll start canary bucket at 15:00 PT. Need ~30m observation before moving to 25%. Who runs smoke tests?
Devon: I will run the smoke scripts. Quick smoke checklist: auth flows, P95 latency delta, model output sanity (sample prompts), error rate <0.1%. I'll post results in this thread.
Samir SRE: I'll watch infra/queues and have rollback ready. Rollback trigger criteria: error rate >0.2% sustained for 10m OR P95 latency >2x baseline for 10m. Rollback steps: toggle routing back to v25-legacy for affected buckets. Example command: 
```bash
redwood route set --env prod --bucket canary-1 --version v25-legacy
```
and re-run smoke. I'll also pre-create the rollback job and keep it paused until needed.
Kevin (QA): Where do we post smoke outputs? Dashboard or this thread? I can push a quick dashboard panel for the canary.
Maria (DevEx): Please post quick snapshots here + link to dashboard. I'll prepare a brief client comms note (email + changelog + migration steps) that mentions the optional header and how clients can opt-in.
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: prod 15:00 PT -> 17:00 PT. Owner: Aj Patel. Canary bucket: canary-1.
Aj Patel: Copy. I'll kick off canary at 15:00 PT and run the scripted smoke suite. Will call out any anomalies.
Liz H: Thanks — plan sounds good. @Aj Patel start canary at 15:00 PT, @Devon run smoke and post results, @Samir SRE standby for rollback. Maria will send client comms after canary looks clean. :thumbsup:
Devon: One more quick Q — do we need to bump client SDK minor to surface the header helper? Maria?
Maria (DevEx): Not required for rollout but we should ship a small SDK patch that exposes a helper to set X-Redwood-Version; timeline: tomorrow morning. We'll include migration snippet in the comms.
Samir SRE: I'll keep a private channel open for the 15:00 run in case we need faster coordination.
Liz H: Perfect. If anything unexpected, call the rollback and tag me. Good luck.
